explanation: The 1905 revolution’s own article carries the claim in the words it is always made in: "Vladimir Lenin later famously described the Revolution of 1905 as the “dress rehearsal” without which the “victory of the October Revolution in 1917 would have been impossible.”" "Without which … would have been impossible" is `precondition-of` exactly. It is Lenin’s judgement and the article attributes it to him, which is why the confidence is `probable` and not `consensus`. The atlas already draws `moscow-uprising-of-1905 --enabled--> october-revolution`; that is one rising inside 1905 and this is the revolution entire, which is the claim the quote makes.
